test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 7 July 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Advent
solution: The correct answer is '**Arrival**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate synonym of the word '**Advent**' is '**Arrival**'. • **Advent**: the fact of somebody/something arriving. [(किसी व्‍यक्ति या घटना का) आगमन] • *Example: The **advent** of the gramophone transformed the cultural conditions of contemporary music, including the way it was taught.* • **Arrival**: reaching the place to which you were travelling. [(किसी स्‍थान पर) आगमन, पहुँच] • *Example: On **arrival**, we were told that our rooms had not been reserved.* **Correct Answer:__** *Arrival.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the meaning of other words: • **Purpose**: the aim or intention of something. [(किसी का) प्रयोजन, उद्देश्‍य, आशय या इरादा] • **Departure**: leaving or going away from a place. (प्रस्‍थान क्रिया, रवानगी) • **Turn**: to move or make something move round a fixed central point. [(किसी वस्‍तु का उसके मध्य बिंदु के चारों ओर) घूमना या (को) घुमाना] 3e:T9ce, The correct answer is '**consistent**'.
